how.title: How it works.
items: Sign up and get API access
Register free, request your API key, and start activating offers and generating trackable links for your clients.
Separate clients with sub-IDs
Tag activity by client and see conversions broken out per client.
Talk to us to scale
Our team helps you pick the right setup — one account with sub-IDs for a combined view, or a separate account per client — and gets you running.
Can I manage more than one client?
Yes. Run all your clients from one account and separate each with sub-IDs, or hold a separate account per client for clean billing. Either way, the API lets you pull the data into your own reporting.
Do I need my own audience or traffic?
No. This path is for agencies running affiliate activity for clients, not for monetising your own audience — if that's you, see the [five publisher types](for-publishers) instead.
How do we integrate technically?
Through our Publisher API — pull offers, generate deeplinks, and sync conversions (with sub-ID breakdowns per client). See the [API page](api-overview) for the endpoints and docs.
How do we keep each client's performance separate?
Use sub-IDs to tag and report activity per client, or run a separate account per client — whichever fits how you bill.
faq.after: Need the technical detail? [See the API page](api-overview). Have your own audience to monetise? [See the five publisher types](for-publishers).
